name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
summary: A foundational upper-arm isolation exercise using dumbbells to build strength and hypertrophy in the elbow flexors.

setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and a slight bend in your knees.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with arms fully extended and palms facing inward toward your thighs.
steps: Keeping your upper arms stationary and elbows tucked close to your ribs, curl the dumbbells upward.
Rotate your wrists outward as you lift, finishing with your palms facing your shoulders in full supination.
Squeeze your biceps firmly at the top of the contraction without allowing your elbows to swing forward.
Lower the dumbbells under strict control along the same path back to full extension at your sides.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you curl the dumbbells upward and inhale as you lower them under control.
cues: Rotate pinkies up at the top

common_faults.fault: Swinging the torso and using hip momentum to lift the weights.
common_faults.correction: Brace your core, keep your torso upright, and reduce the weight so only the forearms move.

common_faults.fault: Drifting elbows excessively forward to take tension off the biceps.
common_faults.correction: Keep your upper arms vertical and fixed in place against your sides throughout the repetition.

common_faults.fault: Cutting the range of motion short at the bottom.
common_faults.correction: Allow your elbows to reach full extension at the bottom of every rep to maximize stretch on the biceps.

precautions: Avoid hyperextending your lumbar spine to hoist the dumbbells.
